Flow: duration of the pubertal spurt (Ho 2026, medRxiv 2026.09.09.26362696)

Source: R/flow-puberty.R
wgh_flow_spurt_duration.Rd

Velocity curves in years since each child's APHV on a fine grid, peak width at 25, 50 and 75 percent of the spurt amplitude (and of PHV, the legacy definition, to show its censoring), censoring flags, ordinary and quantile regressions of duration on prepubertal BAZ adjusted for timing and intensity, a sex-interaction test and functional PCA of the curves.

Usage

wgh_flow_spurt_duration(x = NULL, mode = NULL, spurt = NULL, seed = 2026)

Arguments

x

Growth data with height, weight and year. When NULL, a simulated wgh_like cohort is generated.

mode

Run mode (see wgh_config()); NULL keeps the current mode.

spurt

Optional report from wgh_flow_pubertal_spurt() on the same data (it is computed when NULL).

seed

Random seed for the subsample of curves used in the functional PCA. The caller's random stream is restored.

Value

A wgh_report.

Examples

# \donttest{
# A small cohort with 14 school years of follow-up, so that both SITAR models are
# well identified and the SITAR fits take well under a minute. On short follow-up
# (such as growdat2_mini) the girls' model is barely identifiable and slow.
long <- wgh_simulate(2500, seed = 1, years = 2012:2025, missing_years = integer(),
                     dropout = c(intercept = -4, age = 0), entry_first_prob = 0.9,
                     style = "book2")$visits
spurt <- wgh_flow_pubertal_spurt(long, mode = "dev")
rep <- wgh_flow_spurt_duration(long, mode = "dev", spurt = spurt)
rep
#> 
#> ── Duration of the pubertal growth spurt (Ho 2026, medRxiv 2026.09.09.26362696) ──
#> 
#> Tables (6): duration_features, censoring, fpca_variance, duration_ols,
#> duration_quantile, sex_interaction
#> Figures (1): fig_duration_by_bmi
#> Model status: 2 ok, 0 failed, 0 skipped
#> Settings: mode = dev
# }
